p: seventh month: Which contains part of September, and part of October.
month: Which must be offered in the beginning of every month.
burnt offering: Which is for morning and evening.
convocation: Which is the feast of reconciliation.
burnt offering: That is, offered every morning and evening.
convocation: Meaning, the feast of the tabernacles.
manner: According to the ceremonies appointed to it.
vows: Beside the sacrifices that you will vow or offer of your own minds.
